_: The model's frame, shared by scripts/build-data.mjs and the raw-data fetchers. origin: the middle of cầu Trường Tiền (x metres east, z metres south of it). bbox: the slab, south/west/north/east in degrees. kx = cos(origin.lat) * 111319.49 m per degree of longitude; kz = 110574 m per degree of latitude (the equatorial value; at 16.47 N the true one is about 110663, so north-south distances read about 0.08 % short — negligible here and kept so every committed grid stays aligned). gridAnchor: the point the 25 m terrain lattice is laid from (the north-west corner of the box it was tuned on); keep it when the bbox changes so no node moves.
